metadata.title: Topological Shaking Numbers and Cabling
metadata.abstract: We give a Seifert-form criterion for upper bounds on topological shaking numbers and prove that isotropic certificates lift under $(m,1)$-cabling.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 用 Seifert form 给 topological shaking number 的上界证书，证明 isotropic certificate 在 (m,1)-cabling 下可提升。
analysis.breakthrough: 提供可传播的 shaking 数代数上界方法。
analysis.limitations: 给的是上界判据，不是一般 shaking 数的精确计算。
analysis.priorityReason: 提供可传播的 shaking 数代数上界方法。

analysisBasis.abstract: We give a Seifert-form criterion for upper bounds on topological shaking numbers and prove that isotropic certificates lift under $(m,1)$-cabling.
